origins.section: A Command Is a Request Held as an Object, So It Can Be Queued, Logged and Run Again
Undo Restores What the Command Saved, So It Must Save a Copy Taken When It Runs
A Command That Timed Out May Still Have Run, So a Blind Retry Runs It Twice
An Idempotency Key Created With the Command Makes the Retry Safe

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-lambda-dedup: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-lambda-dedup: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-lambda-dedup: A Command Is a Request Held as an Object...: 'A lambda has no `equals` of its own, so two identical adjustments are two different objects, and a queue can't drop a duplicate.' The run prints 'lambdas equal: false' and 'records equal: true'. So contains() finds no equal job and both are added.
recorded.prompt:q-recolor-shapes: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recolor-shapes: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recolor-shapes: Undo Restores What the Command Saved...: 'Copy every mutable level. List.copyOf copies the list, which is enough because String is immutable. A Map<String, List<String>> copied with new HashMap<>(map) shares its inner lists ... Copy each list as well, or keep immutable values in the receiver.' The stem has the same shape: a list copy that holds mutable Shape objects, so the undo restores shapes that are now red. The page decides this by analogy (inner lists there, Shape objects here).
recorded.prompt:q-reserve-timeout: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reserve-timeout: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-reserve-timeout: A Command That Timed Out May Still Have Run...: 'After a timeout the request may never have arrived, may have been applied with the reply lost, or may still be in progress, and the caller can't tell which.' And: 'Cancelling the timed-out Future doesn't undo anything: cancel(true) interrupts a local thread (unit 6.1.3), and the remote side may already have applied the charge.' The 'no key' run shows two charges applied.
recorded.prompt:q-second-attempt: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-attempt: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-second-attempt: An Idempotency Key Created With the Command...: 'With a key per attempt, the service saw two different charges. The key names the request, not the attempt: it is created where the intent is ... and every retry sends the same command object.' Reference table: 'change by an amount, a new key per attempt | applied twice'.

recorded.prompt:q-lambda-dedup:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-lambda-dedup:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-lambda-dedup:a: Same paragraph: two identical lambdas are 'two different objects'. Output: 'lambdas equal: false'.
recorded.prompt:q-lambda-dedup:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-lambda-dedup:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-lambda-dedup:b: Same paragraph: a lambda's 'arguments sit in its body or in captured variables that nothing outside can read'. So the queue cannot compare captured arguments.
recorded.prompt:q-lambda-dedup:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-lambda-dedup:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-lambda-dedup:d: Refuted only by implication. The page puts the missed duplicate down to the lambda having no equals of its own ('so ... a queue can't drop a duplicate'). It never says outright that contains() calls equals. The 'says' claim 'contains() does call equals' is correct Java, but the page does not state it.
recorded.prompt:q-recolor-shapes:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recolor-shapes:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recolor-shapes:a: Same 'Copy every mutable level' paragraph: a collection copy shares its mutable elements (new HashMap<>(map) 'shares its inner lists'). So new ArrayList does not copy the shapes.
recorded.prompt:q-recolor-shapes:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recolor-shapes:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recolor-shapes:b: Same paragraph: the saved shapes are the shared, mutated objects. Partly true: replaceShapes does put the saved shapes back, but they are already red, so the predicted outcome is wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-recolor-shapes:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-recolor-shapes:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-recolor-shapes:d: The page contrasts saving a reference ('doc.lines() at (1) returns the document's own list, not a copy') with a copy (List.copyOf, and new HashMap<>(map) called a 'copy'). So new ArrayList<>(...) is a separate list, and the reason d gives is wrong. The page never names new ArrayList specifically, so this holds by analogy.

recorded.outcome:q-reserve-timeout:d: Same passage: after a timeout the request 'may never have arrived ... and the caller can't tell which', so the timeout does not show the request arrived. The yes is right but the reason is wrong, which the 'says' text explains correctly.

recorded.prompt:q-second-attempt:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-attempt:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-second-attempt:d: Reference table: 'one key, results stored per key | applied once, the first result returned'. Section: the receiver 'returns the stored result'. Caveat: the page names server-side ways a keyed retry can still charge twice (containsKey-then-put; apply failing after the money moved). d's general claim is false, but a server-side cause is not ruled out; the stem's 'likeliest' covers this.
